title: Learn to Rank: Visual Attribution by Learning Importance Ranking
abstract: arXiv:2604.05819v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Interpreting the decisions of complex computer vision models is crucial to establish trust and accountability, especially in safety-critical domains. An established approach to interpretability is generating visual attribution maps that highlight regions of the input most relevant to the model's prediction. However, existing methods face a three-way trade-off. Propagation-based approaches are efficient, but they can be biased and architecture-specific. Meanwhile, perturbation-based methods are causally grounded, yet they are expensive and for vision transformers often yield coarse, patch-level explanations. Learning-based explainers are fast but usually optimize surrogate objectives or distill from heuristic teachers. We propose a learning scheme that instead optimizes deletion and insertion metrics directly. Since these metrics depend on non-differentiable sorting and ranking, we frame them as permutation learning and replace

translated_title: 学习排序：通过学习重要性排序实现视觉归因
translated_abstract: 解释复杂计算机视觉模型的决策对于建立信任和问责制至关重要，尤其是在安全攸关的领域。一种成熟的可解释性方法是生成视觉归因图，突出显示输入中与模型预测最相关的区域。然而，现有方法面临三重权衡。基于传播的方法效率高，但可能存在偏差且依赖于特定架构。同时，基于扰动的方法具有因果基础，但计算成本高昂，且在视觉Transformer上往往只能产生粗糙的补丁级解释。基于学习的解释器速度快，但通常优化的是代理目标函数或从启发式教师模型中蒸馏知识。我们提出了一种新的学习方案，直接优化删除和插入指标。由于这些指标依赖于不可微分的排序操作，我们将其框架化为排列学习问题，并用……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种将视觉归因中的重要性排序框架化为排列学习的训练方案，直接优化删除和插入指标，从而克服了现有基于传播、扰动和学习的方法在效率、因果性和解释质量之间的三重权衡。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a learning scheme that frames importance ranking in visual attribution as permutation learning to directly optimize deletion and insertion metrics, overcoming the three-way trade-off among efficiency, causality, and explanation quality in existing propagation-based, perturbation-based, and learning-based methods.
